dependency_evidence: Freeze host definition as complete life-cycle/reproduction support. Center et al. state N. eichhorniae cannot switch to alternative hosts and feeds/reproduces only on water hyacinth; 2021 host-spectrum experiments independently report complete life-cycle development only on water hyacinth.
witness_selection_rule: Use exactly ten unambiguous single-coordinate Table-1 populations with N. eichhorniae >0: AU, CH, SI, SAG, SAW, SAK, UG, UR, FL, TX. SAE is N. eichhorniae-negative. CA is prospectively excluded because the population row combines two printed localities/coordinates and is unnecessary for the 10-site floor.
host_range_authority: Center 2010 and Hopper 2019: water hyacinth native to South America and globally naturalized/invasive; frame is not derived from witness coordinates or snapshot occurrence.
known_boundary: Current GBIF taxonomy resolves Neochetina eichhorniae as exact accepted key 4290716. Eichhornia crassipes key 2765940 is a HOMOTYPIC_SYNONYM directly pointing to accepted Pontederia crassipes key 2765942, matching the predeclared Kew homotypic-synonym relation. The exact frozen 8-control interaction screen passes under the predeclared complete-life-cycle host definition. Snapshot taxonomy identity, occurrence, model, invariant, and knockout layers remain unopened.
